source: Add plan controls, workflow progress, and calculated CD impact

assumptions.text: The three-step indicator uses Compass Progress because this repository has no Stepper primitive.
Premium calculation uses a fixed 1.8-second loading state before advancing to Preview and submit.
Premium breakdown, taxes, deduction, and resulting CD balance are demonstration values matching the supplied reference.
Unchecking Same as employee reveals dependent-specific GMC Base, Secondary, Top-up, and Add-on selects.
GMC and GPA plan names shown in the references are represented as selectable demonstration options.
Section differentiation uses only subtle opacity variations of semantic muted, accent, secondary, and primary tokens.
Add employee remains directly beside the employee Tabs at all responsive sizes.
Any form edit after calculation resets the workflow to Fill data and clears the calculated result.
